official_rules.free_daily_gpu_quota: 5 minutes (medium queue priority); unauthenticated 2 minutes; quota resets exactly 24 hours after first GPU use

hardware.large: half NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell, 48 GB VRAM, 1x quota cost
hardware.xlarge: full RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell, 96 GB, 2x quota cost

official_rules.hosting_free_personal: accounts in good standing (verified email, account older than 30 days) can host up to 2 ZeroGPU Spaces for free
official_rules.hosting_pro: PRO can host up to 10 (NOT used: no PRO purchase)
official_rules.paid_extension: PRO/Team/Enterprise only, pre-paid credits at $1 per 10 minutes (NOT used: no payment method, no credits)

runtime.model_loading: models are placed on cuda at module level; a CUDA emulation mode runs outside @spaces.GPU (no GPU quota used); real CUDA only inside @spaces.GPU

quota_plan.rule: respect the legitimate daily quota; if a window is exhausted, preserve phase state and continue only when free quota legitimately returns; no multiple accounts, no token rotation, no quota bypass

result_meaning: No authenticated Hugging Face session is available to this agent, so eligibility can be neither confirmed nor refused. This is NOT HF_ZEROGPU_NOT_ELIGIBLE (the account was not shown to be ineligible) and it is NOT eligible.
resume_requirements: the owner logs in to Hugging Face in the Chrome session (an account with verified email older than 30 days)
read-only verification of profile join date, email verified flag, billing (no payment method) and the ZeroGPU quota display
a Space runner and evidence writer validated in CI before any GPU quota is used
unverified_risks: ZeroGPU Space CPU RAM and disk are not published in the docs; loading the largest control (Phi-4, 29.3 GB BF16) at module level needs enough CPU RAM/disk, which is unproven
free quota is only 300 GPU-seconds per day; each control is planned within a small @spaces.GPU duration and controls run one at a time across quota windows without evasion
